result.summary: Wrote r2/lit.md covering the 4 literature topics from r2/analysis.md §5 (intraday order-flow tilt / core A; higher-moment denominator choice / head +1.22's R group; overnight-vs-intraday split / N idea 1; intraday trade timing / N idea 2). For each topic, searched and where possible WebFetch-verified pre-2023-08-08 sources (Lee & Ready 1991; Chordia-Roll-Subrahmanyam 2002/2005; Admati & Pfleiderer 1988; Jain & Joh 1988; Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2010; Jones-Shi-Zhang-Zhang working paper 2019/2022; Bailey-Cai-Cheung-Wang 2009; Bogousslavsky & Collin-Dufresne 2019 WP; Amaya-Christoffersen-Jacobs-Vasquez 2013 WP/2015 JFE (read PDF directly); Bollerslev-Li-Zhao 2020; Patton & Sheppard 2015; Ahadzie & Jeyasreedharan 2020; Hong & Stein 2003; Lou-Polk-Skouras 2019; Berkman-Koch-Tuttle-Zhang 2012; Qiao & Dam 2020; Jiang-Luo-Ye 2023-05; Gao-Han-Li-Zhou 2018; Andersen & Bollerslev 1997; Han-Zhao-Chen-Guo 2022), each with title/authors/year-month/venue/link/verified flag, translated into operator-language ('day_*'/'cross_*'/'in_index' etc.) processing suggestions, and explicitly marked several sub-questions as 'not found' rather than fabricating (e.g. no literature normalizes realized higher moments by a volume power; no literature attributes VW-EW intraday spread to U-shape composition; no literature on closing-auction-share predicting returns). Excluded all post-2023-08-08-published versions (e.g. used only the pre-cutoff working-paper version of Jones et al., not its 2024/2025 published form).
